privacy.label: // LEGAL
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At SupaFlow, we take your privacy seriously. This policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you interact with our services.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content:
When you engage with SupaFlow, we may collect the following categories of information:

Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and company details provided when you book a call, submit a contact form, or enter into a service agreement.

Project Information: Design briefs, brand assets, content, and other materials you share with us during the course of a project.

Usage Data: Anonymous analytics data including pages visited, time spent on site, browser type, device information, and referring URLs. We use this to improve our website experience.

Communication Records: Email correspondence, call notes, and project feedback exchanged between you and our team.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
We process your information exclusively for the following purposes:

- To deliver design, development, and creative services as agreed in our project scope
- To schedule and conduct introductory calls and project meetings
- To send project updates, deliverables, and invoices
- To improve our website performance and user experience
- To respond to your inquiries and provide client support
- To comply with legal obligations and protect our legitimate business interests

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
sections.content:
Your data is stored on secure, encrypted servers provided by industry-leading infrastructure partners. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

These measures include:
- End-to-end encryption for data in transit (TLS 1.3)
- Encrypted storage at rest (AES-256)
- Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
- Strict access controls limited to authorized team members
- Automated backup systems with geographic redundancy

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.content:
We use the following third-party services in the operation of our business:

- Cal.com - Scheduling and calendar management
- Vercel - Website hosting and deployment
- Supabase - Database and file storage
- Google Analytics - Anonymous website usage analytics

Each third-party provider operates under their own privacy policy. We select partners who demonstrate strong data protection practices and GDPR compliance.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.content:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

- Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
- Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
- Erasure: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
- Portability: Request transfer of your data in a machine-readable format
- Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
- Restriction: Request limitation of processing in certain circumstances

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at hello@supaflow.in. We will respond within 7 working days.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.content:
Our website uses essential cookies required for basic functionality (session management, security). We use anonymous analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
sections.content:
We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy:

- Active project data: Duration of the project plus 2 years for warranty and support purposes
- Financial records: 7 years as required by tax regulations
- Communication records: 3 years after last interaction
- Analytics data: 26 months (anonymized)

Upon expiration of these periods, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. Material changes will be communicated via email to active clients. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when the policy was most recently revised.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.content:
For privacy-related inquiries, data requests, or concerns:

Email: hello@supaflow.in
Response Time: Within 7 working days

If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

terms.label: // LEGAL
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your engagement with SupaFlow for digital design and development services. By commissioning work from us, you agree to the following conditions.

sections.title: 1. Scope of Services
sections.content:
SupaFlow provides premium digital design and development services including, but not limited to: website design, web application development, brand identity systems, motion design, and creative direction.

The specific scope, deliverables, timeline, and compensation for each engagement are defined in a separate Statement of Work (SOW) or project proposal, which forms part of these Terms upon acceptance by both parties.

sections.title: 2. Project Engagement
sections.content:
Proposal & Acceptance: Each project begins with a discovery call followed by a detailed proposal. Work commences only upon written acceptance (email confirmation is sufficient) and receipt of the agreed deposit.

Timelines: Project timelines provided in proposals are estimates based on the defined scope. Delays caused by late client feedback, scope changes, or third-party dependencies may extend the timeline without penalty to SupaFlow.

Communication: We maintain clear, responsive communication throughout every project. Primary communication channels, meeting cadence, and feedback processes are established at project kickoff.

sections.title: 3. Payment Terms
sections.content:
Structure: Unless otherwise agreed, projects follow a milestone-based payment structure:
- 50% deposit upon project commencement
- 25% at design approval
- 25% upon final delivery

Invoicing: Invoices are issued via email and payable within 14 days of receipt. Accepted payment methods include bank transfer, Wise, and Stripe.

Late Payments: Invoices unpaid after 14 days incur a 1.5% monthly late fee. Work may be paused on accounts with outstanding balances exceeding 30 days.

Expenses: Third-party costs (stock assets, premium fonts, hosting, domain registration, API subscriptions) are billed separately at cost unless pre-approved and included in the project budget.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.content:
Client Ownership: Upon receipt of full and final payment, all custom design work, code, and deliverables created specifically for the client's project are transferred to the client with full ownership rights.

Pre-existing IP: Tools, frameworks, libraries, and reusable code components developed by SupaFlow prior to or independently of the project remain the property of SupaFlow. The client receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use these elements within the delivered project.

Open Source: Projects may incorporate open-source software governed by their respective licenses (MIT, Apache 2.0, etc.). These licenses are documented in the project's dependency manifest.

Portfolio Rights: SupaFlow retains the right to showcase completed work in portfolios, case studies, and marketing materials unless explicitly restricted in the SOW.

sections.title: 5. Client Responsibilities
sections.content:
To ensure successful project delivery, the client agrees to:

- Provide all required content, assets, brand guidelines, and access credentials in a timely manner
- Designate a single point of contact with decision-making authority
- Provide consolidated feedback within the agreed review periods (typically 5 business days)
- Ensure all materials provided do not infringe third-party intellectual property rights
- Maintain active communication and attend scheduled meetings

Failure to meet these responsibilities may result in project delays, which will not constitute a breach by SupaFlow.

sections.title: 6. Revisions and Scope Changes
sections.content:
Included Revisions: Each project phase includes a defined number of revision rounds as specified in the SOW (typically 2 rounds per phase). Revisions within scope are included in the project fee.

Out-of-Scope Changes: Requests that materially alter the agreed scope, add new features, or require reworking approved deliverables constitute scope changes. These will be quoted separately and require written approval before implementation.

Design Direction Changes: A complete change in design direction after approval of concepts constitutes a restart of that phase and is billed accordingly.

sections.title: 7. Warranties and Limitations
sections.content:
Quality Assurance: SupaFlow warrants that all deliverables will be crafted with professional care and skill, meeting industry standards for quality, performance, and accessibility.

Bug Fixes: A 30-day warranty period follows final delivery, during which bugs, broken functionality, and rendering issues directly attributable to our code are fixed at no additional cost.

Limitation of Liability: SupaFlow's total liability for any claim arising from a project shall not exceed the total fees paid by the client for that specific project. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or incidental damages including lost revenue or data.

Third-Party Services: We do not warrant the continued availability, performance, or pricing of third-party services (hosting providers, APIs, CMS platforms) integrated into deliverables.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.content:
By Client: The client may terminate the engagement at any time with 14 days written notice. Fees for completed milestones and work-in-progress (prorated at hourly rate) are due upon termination. The deposit is non-refundable.

By SupaFlow: We reserve the right to terminate an engagement due to: non-payment exceeding 30 days, repeated failure to provide required materials, abusive conduct toward team members, or requests to produce illegal or harmful content.

Deliverables on Termination: Upon termination and settlement of all outstanding payments, the client receives all completed deliverables up to the termination date.

sections.title: 9. Confidentiality
sections.content:
Both parties agree to maintain the confidentiality of proprietary information shared during the engagement, including but not limited to: business strategies, unreleased products, financial data, user data, and technical architecture.

This obligation survives termination of the engagement for a period of 2 years.

Exceptions: Information that is publicly available, independently developed, or required to be disclosed by law.

sections.title: 10. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with applicable law. Any disputes arising from these Terms or related engagements shall first be addressed through good-faith negotiation. If unresolved after 30 days, disputes may be submitted to binding arbitration.

sections.title: 11. Amendments
sections.content: SupaFlow reserves the right to update these Terms. Changes take effect 30 days after posting. Existing project agreements remain governed by the Terms in effect at the time of signing unless both parties agree to updated terms in writing.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.content:
For questions regarding these Terms of Service:

Email: hello@supaflow.in
Response Time: Within 7 working days
